pages.text: The worktable is a primitive version of the crafting table.$(br2)Items must be placed on the 9 slots by right-clicking them.$(br2)Once the correct items have been placed, use a $(l:basics/crude_hammer)hammer$() and right-click the top of the worktable to craft the item.
Sneaking while looking at an item inside a storage container shows how many of that item are available.$(br2)Using the scroll wheel while sneaking either adds or removes items.
